name: Pork Chops with Raspberry-Coconut Salsa, Snap Peas & Garlic Rice

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 (170 g) pkg raspberries
1 small pkg fresh mint
3 (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water. Set aside to drain.
Peel and mince garlic; trim and cut green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, green onion, rice, and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add broth to the saucepan and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer chops to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
While the chops are cooking, roughly chop raspberries and place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince shallots; add to the bowl with the raspberries.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with coconut, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper; gently stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup shredded unsweetened coconut
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium heat. Add snap peas, water, salt, and pepper; stir to combine, cover, bring to a simmer, and cook until just fork-tender, about 4 minutes. Uncover and continue to cook until liquid has evaporated, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup water
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice, chops, snap peas, and raspberry-coconut salsa between plates. Enjoy!
